# katana_model_local

**Tag**: web, testing

## 简介

Local DB plugin for katana_model. A package that models data into documents and collections and allows Firestore, local DB, and data mocks to be handled in the same interface.

## 官网

- 主页: https://mathru.net
- 源码仓库: https://github.com/mathrunet/flutter_masamune/tree/master/packages/katana_model_local
- pub.dev: https://pub.dev/packages/katana_model_local
